column1: # Windows font substitutes. Every VNDegen engine reads this table through vnfont_resolve (Engines/Shared/vnfont.h)
# or the FontPack Swift module. docs/fonts.md explains each choice.
# One line per Windows font name and style: name, style (regular, bold, italic, or bold-italic), the substitute's
# file name, and its face index in a collection (0 for a single font). Columns are separated by one tab. Lookups ignore
# ASCII case, spaces, full-width forms of ASCII letters, and a leading @, so "ＭＳ Ｐゴシック", "MS Pゴシック" and
# "ms pgothic" all match the same lines. A style with no line of its own falls back to regular, and the caller draws
# it bolder or slanted. Lines whose file isn't installed, such as the Chinese and Korean fonts before the player
